g.title: LangGraph
g.text: StateGraph(GraphState) · every node wrapped by @contract(reads, writes, agent) · checkpointer: InMemorySaver (Postgres optional) · thread_id = run_id · recursion_limit 40 · run timeout 90 s

g.title: cluster_sense
g.text: payload validated (extra=forbid); node never sees shared state

g.title: cluster_domain
g.text: only domains with a shortfall · private state by construction

g.title: triage
g.text: worst open severity (SQL) · standing orders in force

g.title: ENTRY
g.text: or POST /agent-graph/run · skipped while the emergency stop is on

g.title: command
g.text: never blocks the plan · debounced 60 s

g.title: optimise
g.text: replan.preview(): the real solve inside a
transaction that is rolled back (dry run)

g.title: REDUCE2
g.text: short of the same capability ≥3 cycles → flag mutual aid

g.title: policy_gate
g.text: officer rejected same move <30 min ago (memory) → held
pulls a unit off an S≥4 incident / guardrail → officer

g.title: human
g.text: run pauses, checkpointed · console Approve / Reject
no answer in 300 s → rejected (safe default)

g.title: dispatch
g.text: refuses if the emergency stop came on meanwhile

g.title: observe
g.text: coverage, unmet · router re-enters on next change

g.title: lg
g.text: keys the node is shown (read-only view); anything else is invisible
the only keys it may return; others → StateViolation, run "blocked"
ScopedMemory namespace access (ACL enforced, every access in the ledger)
: Send fan-out · yellow boxes: reducers merging parallel writes
